test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Economic Survey 2020-21, imports are expected to decline by ______ in the second half of FY21.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11.3%.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **According to the Economic Survey, 2020-21 exports are expected to decline by 5.8 percent and imports by 11.3 percent in the second half of the year.**
 
• **The Economic Survey of India is an annual document of the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. **
 
• The Department of Economic Affairs
